slug: 2025-06-10 Guinea-Bissau deploys efforts to digitize birth registration, national ID systems

systems.system: SIREC (Integrated System of Citizen Registers and Statistics)
systems.owner: Civil Registration Office, Ministry of Justice

GNB.note: Integration named is of birth registration with health and education, not with the ID system.
Gives birth registration at about 46% of under-fives, no count or share enrolled in the ID.
Names UNDP support for modernising, but not who operates or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Guinea-Bissau already has a functional biometric national ID card system, being modernised under a Swiss-financed UNDP 'Building National ID' project, and has fully operationalised the ECOWAS ENBIC biometric ID card.
